subject: english
stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “He liked the desk”?
options: It becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop
It had shown a quiet kind of kindness: making room for others even when it costs comfort
It reminded him of many school days: difficult tests, funny notes, and quiet reading time
People learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It had shown a quiet kind of kindness: making room for others even when it costs comfort」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「it reminded him of many school days: difficult tests, funny notes, and quiet reading time」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
